تعتنقون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَنِقُونَ (taʕtaniqūna) /taʕ.ta.ni.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# تُعْتَنَقُونَ (tuʕtanaqūna) /tuʕ.ta.na.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
